_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Run tests on every push
scenarios.description: Check out the code and run the tests. Nothing is written back.

scenarios.label: Build and publish artefacts
scenarios.description: Build the project and upload the result somewhere.

scenarios.label: Lint and comment on pull requests
scenarios.description: Run the linters and post the findings.

scenarios.label: Auto-merge dependency updates
scenarios.description: Update, test and commit back to the repository without a person.

scenarios.label: Deploy to production
scenarios.description: Use the deploy credentials to push to the live environment.

scenarios.label: Release with signed tags
scenarios.description: Tag, sign and push releases to other repositories.
